senses.gloss:
पृदाकु पृदाकु, उस्, m. or पृदाकू, ऊस्, f. (said
to be fr. rt. पर्द्), an adder, viper, snake, serpent; (उस्),
m. a scorpion; a tiger; a panther (= चित्रक); an
elephant; a tree.
—पृदाकु-सानु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved.
having a surface like that of a serpent; smooth or
variegated or shining like a serpent; (according to
Sāy.) having the head uplifted like a serpent.
